title: Step 70-D Inventory administration
description: Implement HIGH-risk Admin Inventory administration for AD-D-06 and AD-D-07 only: source-proven inventory read/status inspection, variant detail/movement/cost/cost-layer probes, warehouse protection update with current If-Match supplied explicitly, and inventory adjustment with exact runtime validation, Project Owner Step-Up and server-owned idempotency. Do not implement transfer/reservation/allocation/procurement/POS workflows or mutate Backend/OpenAPI/database/Product Design/Storefront/Current-State/Step71.

dependencies.item: 70-C shared Admin Inventory Procurement POS foundation

evidence.read_contract_limit: Canonical generated inventory GET responses do not currently expose typed response bodies. Stage70-D must not bypass generated authority or invent response shapes; read surfaces may prove endpoint/status/request-id only.
frozen_inventory_invariants: FIFO cost layers order by receivedAt then id
encumbered stock may not be undercut
warehouse protection source default remains 20 percent

acceptance_criteria.description: Stage70-D reuses createAdminAuthBridge and canonical generated request types. Browser code receives no raw Admin credential authority and no parallel API client is introduced.

Inventory overview supports only the six source-proven GET reads frozen by the task. Because canonical responses are not typed, the UI does not invent inventory record fields; it reports endpoint/status/request-id and requires explicit variant IDs for variant-scoped probes.

Inventory adjustment accepts exactly the seven runtime-defined adjustment types, requires a nonzero integer delta and a trimmed reason of at least two characters; damage/quarantine/quarantine_release/damaged_disposal require positive delta; ordinary positive count/receipt/manual increases require nonnegative integer unit cost.

Inventory adjustment requires WebAuthn Step-Up and sends an Idempotency-Key generated server-side for that submission. Network/timeout/5xx yields unknown outcome; the UI never automatically retries and instructs the operator to inspect authoritative movements first.

Warehouse protection accepts finite 0..100 only, requires explicit current positive entity version converted to If-Match, preserves backend conflict semantics, and never overwrites after 409/412/428 without a fresh version.
No warehouse create/delete/archive/type mutation is exposed in 70-D; no transfer/reservation/allocation/consume-sale/procurement/POS mutation is exposed. Those remain later Step70 stages.
Admin canonical verification includes a deterministic Step70-D verifier and preserves all inherited Step67-70-C verification.

HIGH-risk closure requires exact-head Canonical CI, Phase A, CodeQL/Independent Security, deterministic Review, exact-artifact ACTIVE Lock and explicit Project Owner exact-artifact Human Gate before protected merge.
Protected merge, exact-SHA postmerge Canonical CI/Phase A/CodeQL and terminal Lock release complete before 70-E mutation.

external_gate_evidence.rule: Step70-D is HIGH risk. Project Owner approval is mandatory only after exact-head technical/security/review evidence and exact-artifact ACTIVE Lock are complete.
